gold_sql: SELECT SUM(list_filter(event_params, p -> p.key = 'value')[1].value.double_value) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase') / COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase') FROM events WHERE country = 'VN' AND event_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-01-01' + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
